style_prefix: Richly textured fantasy-industrial storybook illustration, precise ink lines, restrained watercolor, worn brass and carved stone, warm amber lamps against cold blue mana, readable silhouettes, humane facial acting, practical machinery, unlettered surfaces.

prompts.prompt: Two-level underground pump house: dry stone gallery above a misty black-water intake, three brass-and-iron pump engines, grated stair, safety rail, chain hoist, arched mana conduit, public gauge and slate.

Four compact dwarf workers at morning handover: young apprentice holding an iron wedge, stern Master with heavy civic seal, bearded journeyworker reading floats, clerk chalking a public slate beside three silent pumps.
Close pump inspection: dwarf apprentice seats a rectangular iron wedge until its red shoulder aligns with the engine casing; journeyworker calls the state; clerk records it beyond a brass rail.
Dwarf clerk carries a large black level slate to a yellow public boundary while a young apprentice gestures and a severe Master waits by an unstamped brass plate.
Chalk-stained dwarf hands draw a crisp geometric null rune right-to-left on black slate; an oily rag waits nearby; a glass water gauge approaches red in soft focus.
High angle through grated iron stair: young dwarf kneels and listens above warm mist, black underground water, three pump rods, a clear chain hoist, and one trembling outlet pipe.
Public pump test ready: three red wedges seated, Master beside bare inspection plate, apprentice at null slate, journeyworker at pressure floats, clerk and copper cans behind yellow line.
Pivotal close-up: pale blue null rune goes dark, then a hair-thin mana line curls around the feed side of a solid iron isolation wedge toward a neighboring pump as its float rises.
Dwarf apprentice repeats a controlled null stroke; the fully seated red wedge remains dark while the same blue loop reforms around its outside; journeyworker watches with hands clear.
Young dwarf rapidly copies a glowing reroute loop onto a clerk's outward-facing black slate while householders watch and a stern Master guards a bare inspection plate.
Dwarf apprentice pulls a heavy isolation wedge from a pump; familiar blue mana fills the conduit and water gauge recovers while the inspection plate remains visibly unstamped.
Young dwarf braces at a brass safety rail and drags shut a long valve handle; bearded worker guards her balance; ripples cross a cup as pipe knocks travel toward a locked wall conduit.
Wide civic tableau: orderly dwarves with copper cans and bakery trough behind yellow line, public slate facing them, Master holding a heavy seal, workers and three pump states visible beyond.
One left pump prepared to run while central pump stays dark behind a flush red wedge; apprentice points between them; Master holds seal over plate; clerk clears a partial-flow row.
Apprentice and clerk exchange a large chalked evidence slate across a yellow line; severe Master stands by a bare plate; empty copper cans and red water gauge crowd the frame.
Iron isolation wedge lies across a brass inspection plate between apprentice and Master; civic seal held apart; journeyworker and clerk witness the refusal; dry gauge visible behind.
Apprentice hangs from red emergency lever; linked cams lift three wedges; pump rods strike misty water; blue mana floods channels; Master catches her sleeve as one float rises too high.

Whole pump-house decision visible at once: three engines, wedges, floats, conduit, seal plate, public slate, red gauge, misty stair, orderly vessel queue, apprentice between machinery and public line.
Left pump carries water, central pump stays isolated, Master stamps a narrow partial-flow record and apprentice marks beneath it; bakery trough receives a measured stream.
Open stone district moot: apprentice and clerk carry chalked slate between them; bakers, laundry workers and lift mechanics gather with empty cans while several Masters arrive carrying civic seals.

Quiet pump-house investigation: bearded worker straps copper listening cup to arched conduit, young apprentice marks pulse times on a board, Master seals route notices, clerk keeps separate public copy.
Stepped underground terrace street: dwarf apprentice carries copper water can among neighbors, bakery trough and laundry buckets beside public spout, workshop record posted under a wall gauge.
